source_text: Recordabor testamenti; non abiciam in finem. Misericordia superstes. Completae Homiliae XVI in Leviticum. Gloria Christo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: I-will-remember covenant; not I-will-cast-away unto end. Mercy surviving. Completed Homilies XVI on Leviticus. Glory to-Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[I will remember the covenant; I will not cast them away utterly >> Bible:Leviticus 26:42-44]]. Mercy remains. Homiliae I–XVI on Leviticus SERIES CLOSEOUT. Glory to Christ. Amen.
